gloss_en: Bonsai says opening cuts were skipped on Revit-exported IFC even for small models; is it a bug?

context_given: Bonsai 0.9, Revit and ArchiCAD IFC, void limit changed
phrasing_notes: plain, asks bug-or-intended, offers to share dataset
answer_summary: Advised the max-voids-per-element Void Limit (default 30) in advanced Open dialog; unresolved, asked for isolated sample file.

gloss_en: Masonry around windows (lintels, sills, bands) is visible in Solibri but missing in Bonsai

gloss_en: IfcConvert crashes with the Manifold kernel on one wall with two openings, one a 2.5 mm sliver

phrasing_notes: structured bug report with kernel table
answer_summary: Mismatched vertex attribute counts in Manifold boolean batch; fixed in PR 9787; PyPI wheel still predated fix.

gloss_en: FreeCAD curved surfaces appear blocky low-poly in Bonsai; how to set Brep tessellation resolution?

gloss_en: Decimating an IfcWall and saving the representation does not persist after reopening, trying to cut IFC file size

phrasing_notes: short, unsure of terms (does not know representation type)
answer_summary: Decimate only works on tessellated geometry; converting to tessellation may not shrink file but lowers face count; overly detailed doors/furniture are often the real culprit.
